events.summary: The Hennepin County Attorney’s Office declined to file felony charges related to Lang’s August 22 Minneapolis City Hall incident, stating that prior communication and logistical coordination between Minneapolis police and Lang’s security detail left no path to prove felony charges beyond a reasonable doubt. Lang had been arrested on probable-cause riot allegations; the office said misdemeanor charges remain possible.
events.reason_for_status: The official Hennepin County Attorney release is dated August 25 and documents the prosecutorial action. CBS Minnesota and the Minnesota Star Tribune independently reported the same decision and explicitly identified Lang as far-right. The event is therefore auto-publishable with high confidence as an official action, while the underlying conduct remains allegation-only, no felony charge was filed, no conviction is implied, and remaining misdemeanor options are preserved.
